name: Shoot
description: Fire the equipped weapon.

name: Overwatch
description: Fire a reaction shot at the first enemy that moves in line of sight during the enemy phase.

name: Reload
description: Refill the clip.

name: Hunker Down
description: Double cover defense until your next turn. Needs cover.

name: Melee
description: Strike an adjacent target.

name: Evac
description: Leave the map from an evac zone tile.

name: Run & Gun
description: After a dash, gain {grantAp} AP that may only be used to shoot. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Close Combat
description: +{crit} crit within {maxDist} tiles.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: The first reaction shot against this soldier each turn misses.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Fire {shots} shots at {aim} aim each for {apCost} AP, then the turn ends. Uses 1 ammo per shot. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Hit & Run
description: A shot at a flanked target refunds {apRefund} AP (once per turn), so the turn does not end.

name: Untouchable
description: After a kill, the next attack against this soldier misses.

name: Killing Zone
description: Overwatch that fires at every mover in line of sight: up to {maxShots} shots, one per mover.

name: Squadsight
description: Can target enemies visible to any squadmate, at any distance in line of sight.

name: Snap Shot
description: May fire after moving, at {aim} aim.

name: Steady Aim
description: +{aim} aim on this soldier's first shot of the mission.

name: Sentinel
description: Reaction shots can crit.

name: Low Profile
description: Half cover counts as full.

name: In The Zone
description: Killing a flanked or uncovered target refunds the action (max {maxPerTurn} per turn).

name: Headshot
description: +{damage} damage. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Suppression
description: Costs {apCost} AP, ends the turn, uses {ammo} ammo. The target gets {aim} aim, and if it moves it takes a reaction shot. Lasts until your next turn.

name: Shredder
description: Hits remove {armorShred} armor permanently.

name: Bulletstorm
description: Firing doesn't end the turn if the soldier hasn't moved this turn.

name: Grenadier
description: +{charges} grenade charge and +{damage} grenade damage.

name: Danger Zone
description: Suppression also covers enemies within {radius} tile of the target; explosives get +{radius} radius.

name: Mayhem
description: +{damage} damage for suppression reaction shots and explosives.

name: Rupture
description: Fires a shot that always crits. The target takes +{damage} damage from all sources for the rest of the mission. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Field Medic
description: +{charges} medkit charge; medkits work at range {range}, diagonals included.

name: Smoke Screen
description: +{charges} smoke grenade, and its radius is +{radius}.

name: Revive
description: Medkits heal {heal} extra HP and revive a bleeding-out soldier to {reviveHp} HP, who keeps 0 AP this turn.

name: Hack
description: Stun a robot within {range} tiles for {stunTurns} turn. Chance: {baseChance} + {perRank} x rank index {perTier} x robot tier. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Sprinter
description: +{mobility} mobility.

name: Savior
description: Medkits heal +{heal}.

name: Overclock
description: Give an ally +{grantAp} AP this turn. Cooldown {cooldown} turns.

name: Overclock
description: +1 AP to an adjacent robot.

name: Double Shot
description: Takes 2 shots per turn; firing doesn't end the turn.

name: Carry
description: Pick up an adjacent downed squadmate or a stunned, capturable Proxy. While carrying: -{mobilityPenalty} mobility and no shooting.

name: Drop
description: Put the carried unit down on a free adjacent tile.

name: Frag Grenade
description: Throw at a tile in sight. Hits everything in the blast, friends included, ignoring cover. Breaks destructible cover and strips robot armor.

name: Smoke Grenade
description: Throw at a tile in sight. Units in the cloud get +defense for 2 turns. Does not block sight.

name: Lace Jammer
description: Throw at a tile in sight. Stuns every Husk in the radius for 1 turn.

name: Breach Charge
description: Place on an adjacent tile. Damages everything around it and turns walls into rubble.

name: Medkit
description: Heal an ally (or yourself), or stabilize a bleeding-out soldier.

name: Arc Stunner
description: Melee a robot or Proxy. A Proxy at 60% HP or less is stunned for good and can be carried out alive.
